title: aisstream.io AIS
description: Worldwide AIS from aisstream.io. The API key comes from secretRefs.apiKey (e.g. env:AISSTREAM_API_KEY) and never appears here. Vessels are streamed over the map clients' viewports and, for the watchlist, everywhere. aisstream.io allows three connections per account; this feed uses up to two.

watchlistMmsi.title: Watchlist (MMSI)
watchlistMmsi.description: Vessels tracked anywhere in the world, even off-screen, on a second connection; nine-digit MMSIs, up to 200

movingIntervalSec.title: Moving vessel interval (s)
movingIntervalSec.description: At most one stored position per moving vessel this often; 0 stores every report

stationaryIntervalSec.title: Stationary vessel interval (s)
stationaryIntervalSec.description: The same for vessels moored, at anchor, aground or slower than the stationary speed

maxAreaSqDeg.title: Largest viewed area (sq deg)
maxAreaSqDeg.description: Above this the viewed area is too large to store every vessel: vessels are counted per grid cell instead; 0 removes the cap

densityCellDeg.title: Density cell (deg)
densityCellDeg.description: Grid cell size for the vessel counts drawn while a view is over the cap

densityWindowSec.title: Density window (s)
densityWindowSec.description: A vessel counts while seen this recently
